text:
nina (AE): FYI Helios wants a perf POC next week. Goal: sustained 950 RPS chat, avg ~9 tokens, target p95 <= 210ms. They need a runbook, heatmap, reserved vs burst cost delta, and a quick security note re: HSM in-region. Can we scope for Tue/Wed?
cal (SE): We can. Proposal: 1) 20m warmup, 2) 60m steady at 950 RPS (poisson), 3) 15m +50% spike to verify graceful degradation. Test two targets: redwood-13b-q4 and redwood-open-7b fallback. Capture p50/p95/p99/p999, batch-size histogram, KV hit rate, and traces for slow requests.
trent (SRE): HSM: customer requires keys in us-west2 HSM. I'll spin a stub to measure key-fetch RTT and run three configs: no-cache, short-cache (50ms), long-cache (500ms TTL). Also enable X-RDW-TRACE headers for 100% tracing during the run.
leo (Sales Ops): Pricing note: baseline tokens/sec ~ 950 * 9 = 8550 t/s. I'll produce reserved commit vs on-demand monthly estimates and a break-even commit size. Will need the measured tokens/req distribution to finalize.
cal (SE): rdw-loadgen examples (poisson + spike):
```
# steady state
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen \ 
  --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 950 --duration 60m \ 
  --arrival poisson --warmup 20m --pfx-cache warm --prompts helios_samples.json

# spike phase
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 1425 --duration 15m --ramp 15s --arrival poisson
```
bench-bot: scheduled staging run 2026-04-15T09:00Z -> artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/helios/1829999999/results.tar.gz
nina (AE): Action items: Cal = runbook + results writeup + heatmap, Leo = pricing lines, Trent = HSM validation + security answers. Please post raw results.json and a 1-page summary for the prospect.
cal (SE): I'll run a 15m smoke Mon evening then full runs Tue/Wed. Plan to attach a 1-page heatmap and latency waterfall plus raw results.json. I'll also document recommended fallback routing to 7b when p99 spikes.
trent (SRE): If HSM adds >6ms median, I'll document trade-offs and propose cached-key handle. I'll surface any legal cert blockers early.
leo (Sales Ops): ACK. I'll draft three pricing scenarios and include sensitivity for +/-25% token variance.
nina (AE): Thanks all. Keep updates here and tag me when results.json is posted. :rocket:
